controls.manifest_consumer: one shared manifest, no per-engine target selection
controls.campaign: new jointly executed campaign; historical responses cannot fill missing cells
controls.order: alternate which engine goes first across cases; serialize per origin across engines
controls.client_cache: Scrapy HTTPCACHE_ENABLED=false; Firecrawl max_age=0, store_in_cache=false; cache hits ineligible
controls.redirects: Client redirects disabled; explicit same-origin robots redirects metered (max 2). Provider intermediate redirects UNKNOWN under approved cloud scope; changed final document URL invalidates content pairing.
controls.headers: same declared User-Agent and Accept-Language where supported; service-level egress/renderer differences explicitly uncontrolled
controls.source_changes: same URL alone is insufficient; verify title/date/body against frozen independent oracle for each observation, otherwise SOURCE_CHANGED_OR_UNKNOWN
controls.missing_oracles: UNKNOWN; neither HTTP success nor engine agreement can serve as ground truth
controls.failures: Preserve both matrix cells. An access restriction stops that URL/origin for BOTH engines; no engine fallback, UA rotation or enhanced-proxy escalation.
controls.selection_freeze: No selecting only URLs where one engine succeeded. B uses actual procurement announcement, not news.
controls.no_aggregate_speed_ranking: One mixed-source run has no statistical performance claim; client durations include provider infrastructure effects.
controls.extensions: Scrapy+Playwright is a separate third group on the exact same E URL and same observable target; not mixed into base scores.
controls.version_test: Separate controlled-input test, fixed original_url/filename, same input bytes per version to both pipelines; never part of live-site scores.
